bio.text: Mark Nair is the Democratic nominee for Texas's 13th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election; he ran unopposed in the Democratic primary, according to the Denton Record-Chronicle.
According to his campaign website, he is a 30-year Amarillo resident and former Amarillo city councilman.

His campaign website also says he is an inventor and entrepreneur with multiple patents, worked for more than 20 years as head of innovation at Anderson Merchandisers, and taught economics and software development at Amarillo College.
